Veći dio je izgrađen za samo 5 mjeseci 1974. godine, zbog izgradnje naftovoda.
Most of it was built in just 5 months in 1974, because of the construction of an oil pipeline.
Put je uzak i uglavnom prekriven šljunkom ili zemljom, a zimi ima snijega i leda.
The road is narrow and mostly covered with gravel or dirt, and in winter there is snow and ice.
Na dijelu od 386 kilometara nema nijedne benzinske pumpe.
On a stretch of 386 kilometres there is not a single petrol station.
Putovanje traje najmanje 13 sati, čak i kada je vrijeme dobro.
The journey takes at least 13 hours, even when the weather is good.
Signal za mobitel ne postoji svugdje, pa vozači kamiona koriste radio-stanice.
There is no mobile phone signal everywhere, so truck drivers use radio sets.
Službe savjetuju da se nose rezervna guma, dodatno gorivo, topla odjeća i hrana.
Authorities advise carrying a spare tyre, extra fuel, warm clothes and food.

title: Švedski golman priznao grešku nakon pobjede protiv BiH
Swedish goalkeeper admits mistake after win against BiH
body: Švedska je u subotu u Solni pobijedila Bosnu i Hercegovinu rezultatom 3:2.
On Saturday in Solna Sweden beat Bosnia and Herzegovina 3:2.
Utakmicu je gledalo rekordnih 51.049 ljudi, a većina su bili navijači BiH.
A record 51,049 people watched the match, and most of them were BiH fans.
Švedska je pobjedom osigurala prvo mjesto u grupi i povratak u Ligu A.
With the win Sweden secured first place in the group and a return to League A.
Švedska je na poluvremenu vodila 3:0, nakon gola Svenssona i dva penala Gyökeresa.
Sweden led 3:0 at half-time, after a goal by Svensson and two penalties by Gyökeres.
U drugom poluvremenu golove za BiH dali su Armin Gigović i Sead Kolašinac.
In the second half Armin Gigović and Sead Kolašinac scored for BiH.
Švedski mediji pišu da je njihova ekipa zadnjih pola sata samo preživljavala.
Swedish media write that their team was only surviving for the last half hour.
Golman Viktor Johansson priznao je da je loše dodao loptu i tako poklonio prvi gol.
Goalkeeper Viktor Johansson admitted that he passed the ball badly and so gifted the first goal.
Rekao je da je bio dužan ekipi i zato je kasnije odbranio nekoliko opasnih udaraca.
He said that he owed it to the team, and later he saved several dangerous shots.
Trener Graham Potter rekao je da je atmosfera bila kao da igraju u gostima.
Coach Graham Potter said that the atmosphere was as if they were playing away.
Švedska u utorak igra u Poljskoj, a BiH će u Zenici igrati protiv Rumunije.
On Tuesday Sweden plays in Poland, and BiH will play against Romania in Zenica.

title: Nedžad Grabus zvanično postao novi reis Islamske zajednice
Nedžad Grabus officially becomes the new reis of the Islamic Community
body: Nedžad Grabus je u nedjelju u Begovoj džamiji u Sarajevu položio zakletvu.
On Sunday Nedžad Grabus took the oath in the Begova Mosque in Sarajevo.
Tako je zvanično preuzeo dužnost reisul-uleme, vođe Islamske zajednice u BiH.
In this way he officially took over the office of reisul-ulema, the leader of the Islamic Community in BiH.
Grabus je rekao da će svoju dužnost obavljati odgovorno i savjesno.
Grabus said that he will carry out his duty responsibly and conscientiously.
Na svečanosti su bili član Predsjedništva BiH Denis Bećirović, diplomate i mnogi vjerski predstavnici.
Member of the BiH Presidency Denis Bećirović, diplomats and many religious representatives were at the ceremony.
Edhem Bičakčić mu je predao menšuru, dokument koji potvrđuje da je izbor zakonit.
Edhem Bičakčić handed him the menšura, a document that confirms that the election is legitimate.
Grabus je izabran 10. oktobra za mandat od 2026. do 2033. godine.
Grabus was elected on 10 October for the term from 2026 to 2033.
Prije toga je bio sarajevski muftija, a od 2006. do 2021. bio je muftija u Ljubljani.
Before that he was the mufti of Sarajevo, and from 2006 to 2021 he was the mufti in Ljubljana.
Dosadašnji reis Husein Kavazović održao je oproštajni govor.
The outgoing reis Husein Kavazović gave a farewell speech.
Zahvalio je muftijama na podršci i zamolio vjernike da podrže novog reisa.
He thanked the muftis for their support and asked the believers to support the new reis.
Grabusu je poželio strpljenje i mudrost u novom poslu.
He wished Grabus patience and wisdom in the new job.
Zanimljivo je da je Grabus prije 14 godina, na istom mjestu, bio u grupi koja je menšuru predala Kavazoviću.
Interestingly, 14 years ago, in the same place, Grabus was in the group that handed the menšura to Kavazović.

title: UKC Tuzla planira novi urgentni centar na pet etaža
UKC Tuzla plans a new five-storey emergency centre
body: Univerzitetski klinički centar Tuzla predstavio je idejno rješenje za novi urgentni centar.
The University Clinical Centre Tuzla presented a conceptual design for a new emergency centre.
Zgrada će imati pet etaža i nalazit će se pored hirurške zgrade Gradina.
The building will have five floors and will be located next to the Gradina surgical building.
Prijem, dijagnostika i hitne operacije bit će na jednom mjestu.
Admission, diagnostics and emergency operations will be in one place.
U prizemlju od 1.648 kvadratnih metara bit će trijaža, sala za reanimaciju, laboratorija i rendgen.
On the ground floor of 1,648 square metres there will be triage, a resuscitation room, a laboratory and X-ray.
Trijaža je sistem koji pacijente dijeli u pet grupa prema tome koliko je hitno da dobiju pomoć.
Triage is a system that divides patients into five groups according to how urgently they need help.
Na prvom spratu planirana je intenzivna njega s dvije izolacione sobe i angio sala.
An intensive care unit with two isolation rooms and an angio room is planned on the first floor.
U podrumu će biti garaža i skladište lijekova, a na vrhu zgrade restoran.
In the basement there will be a garage and a medicine warehouse, and at the top of the building a restaurant.
Direktor Šekib Umihanić rekao je da je to jedan od najvažnijih projekata ove ustanove.
Director Šekib Umihanić said that it is one of the most important projects of this institution.
Kako je objasnio, cilj je skratiti vrijeme od prijema do početka liječenja.
As he explained, the goal is to shorten the time from admission to the start of treatment.
Pacijenti tako ne bi morali često prelaziti s jedne klinike na drugu.
In this way patients would not have to move often from one clinic to another.

title: Britanski špijunski avioni 17 puta letjeli kod Kalinjingrada
British spy planes flew near Kaliningrad 17 times
body: Dva britanska izviđačka aviona Rivet Joint u oktobru su 17 puta letjela kod ruske regije Kalinjingrad.
Two British Rivet Joint reconnaissance planes flew near the Russian region of Kaliningrad 17 times in October.
Avioni su polijetali iz baze Waddington u Engleskoj, a podatke o letovima analizirao je Daily Mail.
The planes took off from the Waddington base in England, and the Daily Mail analysed the flight data.
Britansko ministarstvo odbrane nije komentarisalo te letove.
The British Ministry of Defence did not comment on those flights.
U oktobru je bilo četiri puta više letova nego u maju, kada su bila samo 4 leta.
In October there were four times more flights than in May, when there were only 4 flights.
Stručnjaci misle da su avioni prikupljali ruske signale i komunikacije.
Experts think that the planes were collecting Russian signals and communications.
Rusija je 30. septembra upozorila NATO da je spremna koristiti i nuklearno oružje ako neko pokuša izolirati Kalinjingrad.
On 30 September Russia warned NATO that it is ready to use even nuclear weapons if someone tries to isolate Kaliningrad.
Ta regija je udaljena oko 400 kilometara od ostatka Rusije i ima rakete Iskander-M.
That region is about 400 kilometres away from the rest of Russia and has Iskander-M missiles.
Bivši britanski obavještajac Philip Ingram rekao je da letovi Rusiji šalju jasnu poruku.
Former British intelligence officer Philip Ingram said that the flights send Russia a clear message.
Poruka je, kako je rekao, da je neko stalno prati.
The message, as he said, is that someone is watching it all the time.
Jedan izvor iz RAF-a ipak tvrdi da je to bila obična operacija na istočnoj granici NATO-a.
However, one RAF source claims that it was an ordinary operation on NATO's eastern border.

title: Kvar na granici popravljen, ali kolone su i dalje duge
Border fault repaired, but the queues are still long
body: Sistem na graničnim prijelazima s Hrvatskom u nedjelju je prestao raditi.
The system at the border crossings with Croatia stopped working on Sunday.
Zbog toga putnici iz BiH neko vrijeme nisu mogli ući u Hrvatsku.
Because of that, travellers from BiH could not enter Croatia for some time.
Kvar je sada popravljen, ali na izlazu iz BiH ostale su duge kolone vozila.
The fault has now been repaired, but long queues of vehicles remained at the exit from BiH.
Prema podacima BIHAMK-a, najduže kolone bile su u Velikoj Kladuši, Izačiću, Gradišci i Orašju.
According to BIHAMK data, the longest queues were in Velika Kladuša, Izačić, Gradiška and Orašje.
Kamere su oko 11:51 pokazale dugu kolonu u dvije trake na prijelazu Izačić.
At around 11:51 the cameras showed a long queue in two lanes at the Izačić crossing.
U Orašju automobili čekaju u jednoj traci, a pored njih stoje kamioni.
In Orašje cars are waiting in one lane, and trucks are standing next to them.
Gužve su nastale i na hrvatskoj strani granice.
Crowds also formed on the Croatian side of the border.
Hrvatske kamere su pokazale automobile, kombije i autobuse u nekoliko traka kod Slavonskog Broda i Gornjeg Varoša.
Croatian cameras showed cars, vans and buses in several lanes near Slavonski Brod and Gornji Varoš.
Vozila su čekala i na prijelazima Stara Gradiška i Svilaj.
Vehicles were also waiting at the Stara Gradiška and Svilaj crossings.
Vozači koji danas putuju u Hrvatsku zato trebaju računati na duže čekanje.
Drivers who are travelling to Croatia today should therefore expect a longer wait.

title: Isključeni Bajramović morao promijeniti mjesto na tribini
Sent-off Bajramović had to change his seat in the stands
body: Zlatan Bajramović, pomoćnik selektora BiH, dobio je crveni karton na utakmici protiv Švedske.
Zlatan Bajramović, assistant to the BiH head coach, got a red card in the match against Sweden.
Nakon toga je morao napustiti klupu i otići na tribinu.
After that he had to leave the bench and go to the stands.
On je prvo sjeo na mjesto odmah iznad klupe BiH.
He first sat in a seat right above the BiH bench.
Službena lica su to primijetila i natjerala ga da se premjesti dalje od klupe.
Officials noticed this and made him move further away from the bench.
Švedski list Aftonbladet piše da 47-godišnji Bajramović nije bio zadovoljan tom odlukom.
The Swedish newspaper Aftonbladet writes that the 47-year-old Bajramović was not happy with that decision.
Bio je nervozan na klupi i prije nego što je isključen.
He was nervous on the bench even before he was sent off.
Crveni karton je dobio u prvom poluvremenu, nakon što je VAR poništio gol Alexandra Isaka zbog ofsajda.
He got the red card in the first half, after VAR cancelled Alexander Isak's goal because of offside.
Taj gol bi Švedskoj donio vodstvo od 3:0.
That goal would have given Sweden a 3:0 lead.
Švedska je na kraju ipak pobijedila rezultatom 3:2.
In the end, Sweden still won 3:2.
Bajramović je kao igrač igrao u veznom redu i odigrao je 35 utakmica za reprezentaciju BiH.
As a player, Bajramović played in midfield and played 35 matches for the BiH national team.

title: Petar Ugren pobijedio na dječijem festivalu u Goraždu
Petar Ugren wins the children's festival in Goražde
body: Petar Ugren pobijedio je na 27. međunarodnom dječijem festivalu „Šta se pjesmom sanja“ u Goraždu.
Petar Ugren won the 27th international children's festival "Šta se pjesmom sanja" in Goražde.
Prvo mjesto je osvojio s pjesmom „Pleši, pleši“.
He won first place with the song "Pleši, pleši".
Festival je održan u velikoj sali Centra za kulturu Goražde.
The festival was held in the large hall of the Centre for Culture Goražde.
Mladi pjevači iz nekoliko zemalja izveli su 14 pjesama.
Young singers from several countries performed 14 songs.
Drugo mjesto su osvojili Ibrahim Bešlija i Mirza Softić s pjesmom „Naši starci“.
Ibrahim Bešlija and Mirza Softić won second place with the song "Naši starci".
Treća je bila Sara Šalaka s pjesmom „Pjevamo suncu“.
Third was Sara Šalaka with the song "Pjevamo suncu".
Žiri je dodijelio i posebne nagrade za najbolji nastup, muziku i tekst.
The jury also gave special awards for the best performance, music and lyrics.
Direktor centra Jasmin Bešlija rekao je da su djeca glavni razlog za ovakve događaje.
The centre's director Jasmin Bešlija said that children are the main reason for events like this.
Dodao je da svako dijete koje izađe na scenu zaslužuje podršku i aplauz.
He added that every child who goes on stage deserves support and applause.
Festival je poznat po tome što se na njemu izvode nove pjesme koje publika prvi put čuje.
The festival is known for new songs being performed there that the audience hears for the first time.

title: Italija kaznila Metu sa 805 miliona eura
Italy fines Meta 805 million euros
body: Italijanska agencija za zaštitu podataka kaznila je kompaniju Meta sa 805 miliona eura.
The Italian data protection agency fined the company Meta 805 million euros.
Meta je vlasnik Facebooka, a agencija tvrdi da je aplikacija ulazila u galerije korisnika bez njihove dozvole.
Meta is the owner of Facebook, and the agency claims that the app accessed users' galleries without their permission.
To se dešavalo na telefonima sa sistemom Android.
This happened on phones with the Android system.
Problem je funkcija koja od 2023. godine korisnicima predlaže fotografije i videe iz galerije za nove objave.
The problem is a feature that since 2023 has suggested photos and videos from the gallery to users for new posts.
Korisnici nisu mogli znati da daju dozvolu i za tu funkciju.
Users could not know that they were also giving permission for that feature.
Prema agenciji, to se odnosi na oko 20 miliona korisnika u Italiji.
According to the agency, this concerns about 20 million users in Italy.
Kazna iznosi oko 0,4 posto godišnjeg prihoda kompanije, koji je 2025. bio 201 milijardu dolara.
The fine is about 0.4 percent of the company's annual revenue, which was 201 billion dollars in 2025.
Meta sada mora posebno pitati korisnike da li dozvoljavaju pristup galeriji.
Meta must now ask users separately whether they allow access to the gallery.
Agencija je rekla i da Meta nije sarađivala tokom istrage.
The agency also said that Meta did not cooperate during the investigation.
Kompanija se ne slaže s odlukom i najavila je žalbu.
The company does not agree with the decision and has announced an appeal.

title: Rubio zaprijetio Međunarodnom krivičnom sudu u Hagu
Rubio threatened the International Criminal Court in The Hague
body: Američki državni sekretar Marco Rubio u petak je oštro napao Međunarodni krivični sud u Hagu.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio sharply attacked the International Criminal Court in The Hague on Friday.
Govorio je u Washingtonu na skupu Federalističkog društva, udruženja konzervativnih pravnika.
He spoke in Washington at a gathering of the Federalist Society, an association of conservative lawyers.
Sud je nazvao lažnim i rekao je da se stavlja iznad zakona suverenih država.
He called the court false and said that it puts itself above the laws of sovereign states.
Rubio je kritikovao to što bi sud mogao istraživati i zatvarati američke građane.
Rubio criticised the fact that the court could investigate and imprison American citizens.
Pri tome je citirao rimskog generala Pompeja, a i sam je priznao da to nije politički korektno.
He quoted the Roman general Pompey, and he himself admitted that this was not politically correct.
Ministar odbrane Pete Hegseth podijelio je njegov govor na mreži X.
Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth shared his speech on the network X.
Dodao je poruku: „Prestanite citirati zakone ljudima s mačevima.“
He added the message: "Stop quoting laws to men with swords."
Prošlog mjeseca Trumpova administracija najavila je nove sankcije protiv suda.
Last month the Trump administration announced new sanctions against the court.
Ranije je već uvela sankcije sudijama i tužiocima tog suda.
It had already introduced sanctions against judges and prosecutors of that court.
Sud je osnovan 2002. godine da sudi za ratne zločine i genocid.
The court was founded in 2002 to try war crimes and genocide.
SAD su potpisale Rimski statut, ali ga nikada nisu ratifikovale, odnosno službeno prihvatile.
The USA signed the Rome Statute, but never ratified it, that is, officially accepted it.

title: Selektor Švedske pohvalio Zmajeve i navijače BiH
Sweden's head coach praised the Dragons and the BiH fans
body: Selektor Švedske Graham Potter pohvalio je igru reprezentacije BiH i njene navijače.
Sweden head coach Graham Potter praised the play of the BiH national team and its fans.
Švedska je u subotu u Solni pobijedila BiH 3:2.
Sweden beat BiH 3:2 in Solna on Saturday.
Tom pobjedom osigurala je prvo mjesto u grupi i ulazak u Ligu A.
With that win it secured first place in the group and entry into League A.
Švedska je na poluvremenu vodila 3:0, ali su Armin Gigović i Sead Kolašinac u drugom poluvremenu postigli dva gola.
Sweden led 3:0 at half-time, but Armin Gigović and Sead Kolašinac scored two goals in the second half.
BiH je do kraja tražila gol za izjednačenje.
BiH looked for an equalising goal until the end.
Utakmicu je gledalo 51.049 ljudi, što je novi rekord švedske reprezentacije na tom stadionu.
The match was watched by 51,049 people, which is a new record for the Swedish national team at that stadium.
Mnogi od njih navijali su za BiH, pa je Potter rekao da su se Šveđani osjećali kao gosti.
Many of them supported BiH, so Potter said that the Swedes felt like guests.
Za televiziju Viaplay rekao je da je njegov tim drugo poluvrijeme počeo previše opušteno.
He told the TV channel Viaplay that his team started the second half too relaxed.
Dodao je da BiH nikada ne odustaje i da je opasna ako dobije malo ohrabrenja.
He added that BiH never gives up and is dangerous if it gets a little encouragement.
Prema njegovim riječima, Švedska je prelako primila golove.
According to him, Sweden conceded the goals too easily.
Žrijeb za kvalifikacije za Euro bit će održan 6. decembra.
The draw for the Euro qualifiers will be held on 6 December.

title: Višak kilograma može brže oslabiti pamćenje
Excess weight can weaken memory faster
body: Novo istraživanje pokazuje da ljudi s više kilograma sa godinama brže gube pamćenje i koncentraciju.
A new study shows that people with more weight lose memory and concentration faster as they age.
Istraživanje su uradili naučnici sa Univerziteta Georgia u SAD-u.
The study was done by scientists from the University of Georgia in the USA.
Rezultati su objavljeni u časopisu Journal of Neurology.
The results were published in the Journal of Neurology.
Naučnici su pratili više od 8.200 odraslih osoba starijih od 50 godina.
The scientists followed more than 8,200 adults older than 50.
Koristili su podatke od 1996. do 2020. godine, dakle iz perioda od 24 godine.
They used data from 1996 to 2020, so from a period of 24 years.
Svakoj osobi su više puta mjerili indeks tjelesne mase, odnosno odnos težine i visine.
They measured each person's body mass index, that is, the ratio of weight to height, several times.
Kada je taj indeks bio veći, slabljenje pamćenja i sposobnosti planiranja bilo je brže.
When that index was higher, the weakening of memory and of the ability to plan was faster.
Veza je bila najjača kod ljudi starijih od 65 godina.
The link was strongest in people older than 65.
Autori studije kažu da ljudi koji kontrolišu težinu mogu značajno usporiti taj pad već za dvije godine.
The authors of the study say that people who control their weight can significantly slow this decline in just two years.
Studija ne dokazuje da višak kilograma direktno uzrokuje problem, ali pokazuje da je težina faktor rizika.
The study does not prove that excess weight directly causes the problem, but it shows that weight is a risk factor.
Lijeka za demenciju nema, zato je važno smanjiti svaki faktor rizika na koji možemo uticati.
There is no cure for dementia, so it is important to reduce every risk factor that we can influence.

title: Švedske legende se oprostile pred gotovo praznim tribinama
Swedish legends said goodbye in front of almost empty stands
body: Nakon utakmice Švedske i BiH u Solni, švedski savez je organizovao oproštaj za pet bivših reprezentativaca.
After the match between Sweden and BiH in Solna, the Swedish federation organised a farewell for five former national team players.
Riječ je o Emilu Forsbergu, Robinu Olsenu, Viktoru Claessonu, Martinu Olssonu i Emilu Krafthu.
They are Emil Forsberg, Robin Olsen, Viktor Claesson, Martin Olsson and Emil Krafth.
Ali kada je ceremonija počela, tribine su bile gotovo prazne.
But when the ceremony began, the stands were almost empty.
Ovih pet igrača zajedno je odigralo 353 utakmice za Švedsku.
These five players together played 353 matches for Sweden.
Ceremonija je počela oko 10 minuta nakon kraja utakmice, iako je savez ranije zamolio navijače da ostanu.
The ceremony started about 10 minutes after the end of the match, although the federation had earlier asked fans to stay.
Na stadionu je bilo 51.049 gledalaca, što je rekord za mušku reprezentaciju Švedske na tom stadionu.
There were 51,049 spectators at the stadium, which is a record for Sweden's men's team at that stadium.
Švedski mediji pišu da su mnogi gledaoci navijali za BiH.
Swedish media write that many spectators were supporting BiH.
Neki švedski listovi nazvali su oproštaj fijaskom.
Some Swedish newspapers called the farewell a fiasco.
Igrač Benjamin Nygren rekao je da je tužno što je tako ispalo.
Player Benjamin Nygren said it was sad that it turned out that way.
Petra Thorén iz saveza objasnila je da se takve ceremonije uvijek održavaju poslije utakmice, a ne na poluvremenu.
Petra Thorén from the federation explained that such ceremonies are always held after the match, not at half-time.
Dodala je da će savez u budućnosti preispitati neke stvari.
She added that the federation will reconsider some things in the future.

title: Poplavljen most kod Kladnja, na prevojima moguća poledica
Bridge flooded near Kladanj, black ice possible on mountain passes
body: Most na regionalnom putu Kladanj – Brateljevići, kod mjesta Muška Voda, poplavljen je, pa je put zatvoren za sva vozila.
The bridge on the regional road Kladanj – Brateljevići, near Muška Voda, is flooded, so the road is closed to all vehicles.
To je u nedjelju ujutro objavio BIHAMK.
BIHAMK announced this on Sunday morning.
Postoji zaobilazni makadamski put, to jest put bez asfalta, ali je u lošem stanju, pa vozači trebaju voziti sporo.
There is an unpaved detour, that is, a road without asphalt, but it is in poor condition, so drivers need to drive slowly.
Ceste u BiH su uglavnom suhe, a samo ponegdje su mokre.
Roads in BiH are mostly dry, and wet only in some places.
Zbog niskih jutarnjih temperatura na višim mjestima i na prevojima moguća je poledica.
Because of low morning temperatures in higher places and on mountain passes, black ice is possible.
U kotlinama je magla, pa je vidljivost mjestimično smanjena.
There is fog in the valleys, so visibility is reduced in places.
Na usjecima postoji opasnost od odrona kamenja.
On road cuttings there is a danger of rockfalls.
BIHAMK savjetuje vozačima da voze oprezno.
BIHAMK advises drivers to drive carefully.
Zimska oprema je obavezna po zakonu.
Winter equipment is mandatory by law.
Na mnogim putevima zbog radova saobraćaj ide samo jednom trakom.
On many roads, because of roadworks, traffic goes in only one lane.
Na granici putnička vozila uglavnom čekaju do 30 minuta, ali zbog novog EU sistema EES čekanje može biti duže.
At the border passenger vehicles mostly wait up to 30 minutes, but because of the new EU system EES the wait can be longer.

title: Toranj SpaceX-a prvi put uhvatio Starship nakon leta u svemir
SpaceX tower caught Starship for the first time after a flight to space
body: Kompanija SpaceX u subotu je prvi put uhvatila letjelicu Starship rukama tornja nakon leta u svemir.
On Saturday the company SpaceX for the first time caught the Starship spacecraft with the arms of a tower after a flight to space.
Letjelica se vratila na lansirnu rampu u Teksasu oko 22 sata nakon polijetanja.
The spacecraft returned to the launch pad in Texas about 22 hours after liftoff.
Mehaničke ruke tornja uhvatile su je dok se vertikalno spuštala.
The tower's mechanical arms caught it as it was coming down vertically.
Raketa je poletjela u petak poslijepodne iz baze SpaceX-a blizu granice s Meksikom.
The rocket lifted off on Friday afternoon from the SpaceX base near the border with Mexico.
Visoka je 124 metra i smatra se najvećom raketom na svijetu.
It is 124 metres tall and is considered the largest rocket in the world.
Starship je u orbitu postavio 26 satelita Starlink i 14 puta obletio Zemlju.
Starship put 26 Starlink satellites into orbit and circled the Earth 14 times.
Prva faza rakete nije uspjela sletjeti, pa se sama uništila iznad Meksičkog zaljeva.
The first stage of the rocket failed to land, so it destroyed itself over the Gulf of Mexico.
SpaceX kaže da je to dokaz da se Starship može koristiti više puta.
SpaceX says this is proof that Starship can be used many times.
NASA plaća milijarde dolara da Starship do kraja ove decenije odveze astronaute na Mjesec.
NASA is paying billions of dollars for Starship to take astronauts to the Moon by the end of this decade.
Šef NASA-e Jared Isaacman napisao je na mreži X da je to bilo gotovo magično.
NASA chief Jared Isaacman wrote on X that it was almost magical.
Inženjeri sada istražuju zašto prva faza nije uspjela.
Engineers are now investigating why the first stage failed.

title: Alajbegović: Bili smo bolji u drugom poluvremenu
Alajbegović: We were better in the second half
body: Reprezentativac BiH Kerim Alajbegović govorio je za BHT1 nakon poraza od Švedske 3:2.
BiH national team player Kerim Alajbegović spoke to BHT1 after the 3:2 defeat by Sweden.
Utakmica je igrana u Solni, a BiH je na poluvremenu gubila 3:0.
The match was played in Solna, and BiH was losing 3:0 at half-time.
Alajbegović misli da je Švedska imala sreće i da je BiH zaslužila barem bod.
Alajbegović thinks that Sweden was lucky and that BiH deserved at least a point.
Rekao je da su igrači u prvom poluvremenu napravili glupe greške.
He said that the players made silly mistakes in the first half.
Švedska je tada dobila dva penala i iz njih postigla dva gola.
Sweden then got two penalties and scored two goals from them.
U drugom poluvremenu BiH je bila mnogo bolja, kaže on.
In the second half BiH was much better, he says.
Alajbegović je imao asistenciju za gol Kolašinca, ali kaže da mu to malo znači nakon poraza.
Alajbegović had the assist for Kolašinac's goal, but says it means little to him after a defeat.
Prema njegovim riječima, selektor Sergej Barbarez im je na poluvremenu rekao da igraju kao da je 0:0.
According to him, head coach Sergej Barbarez told them at half-time to play as if it were 0:0.
Pohvalio je i navijače i rekao da su navijači BiH najbolji na svijetu.
He also praised the fans and said that BiH fans are the best in the world.
Sljedeću utakmicu BiH igra kod kuće u Zenici, gdje je atmosfera uvijek luda.
BiH plays its next match at home in Zenica, where the atmosphere is always crazy.
